findings: Existing arch_budget_qwen3 source already assigns KV to each die's HBM with layer-next prefetch and current-row tail; do not invent another storage architecture.
Existing workload KV FP8 read charge for TP4 8K is 150994944 B/die/token, exactly the earlier conditional 36-window refill byte bound. Incremental full-reload bytes to add is zero.

rom_token already maxes compute with aggregate KV bandwidth. qwen_tp_point uses KV bandwidth for saturated bounds/capacity, while its single-user cycles lack a finite accepted-response/refill/visibility calendar. Finite exposed waits remain unknown.

Retained RTL has layer-local addresses and host global-KV/reset service. Generic ot_hdc_kv_stream supports layer-bearing global addresses/window/tail but is not connected to current tile fills; hq_rdy is request acceptance, no explicit writer completion ACK input.
request: Retain existing per-layer HBM policy. Bind extents/owner/lifetime translation into local A24 images, actual fill lane/port/credit/buffer/CDC/codec dimensions and completion/read visibility. Reconcile existing transfer terms once, then price incremental finite waits/hops; no new topology/depth sweep or heavy build.
subject: Reconcile existing ROM HBM KV residence and finite service before pricing successor
